package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

var _ repository.NextActionSnapshotReader = (*LearningJourneyRepoPG)(nil)

// ReadNextActionSnapshot reads Student facts in one read-only repeatable-read
// transaction. Runtime state is obtained separately through its bounded owner
// projection; this read never changes assignments, evidence or activity state.
func (repo *LearningJourneyRepoPG) ReadNextActionSnapshot(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.NextActionSnapshot, error) {
	if repo == nil || repo.Pool == nil {
		return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, errors.New("learning journey repository pool is required")
	}
	if !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(studentID) {
		return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	tx, err := repo.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{IsoLevel: pgx.RepeatableRead, AccessMode: pgx.ReadOnly})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	source, err := readNextActionSnapshot(ctx, tx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, err
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, err
	}
	return source, nil
}

func readNextActionSnapshot(ctx context.Context, q learningPathQuerier, studentID string) (domain.NextActionSnapshot, error) {
	source := domain.NextActionSnapshot{StudentID: studentID}
	contextValue, err := getLearningContext(ctx, q, studentID, false)
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, err
	}
	if err == nil {
		source.Context = contextValue
	}
	if contextValue.SelectedLearningPathID != "" {
		// Unlike the S10 workspace, NBA needs the exact selected route even when
		// paused or completed. Ownership is enforced by getLearningPathByID.
		path, err := getLearningPathByID(ctx, q, studentID, contextValue.SelectedLearningPathID, false)
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, domain.ErrStateChanged
		}
		if err != nil {
			return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, err
		}
		path.IsSelected = true
		source.SelectedPath = &path
		answers, err := q.Query(ctx, `SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.learning_path_item_id,a.requirement_id)
a.learning_path_item_id::text,a.requirement_id::text,a.id::text,a.status
FROM student_task_answer a
JOIN student_learning_path_item i ON i.id=a.learning_path_item_id
JOIN student_learning_path p ON p.id=i.student_learning_path_id AND p.student_id=a.student_id
WHERE a.student_id=$1 AND p.id=$2 AND a.requirement_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.learning_path_item_id,a.requirement_id,a.created_at DESC,a.attempt DESC,a.id DESC`, studentID, path.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, err
		}
		for answers.Next() {
			var answer domain.NextActionAnswerState
			if err := answers.Scan(&answer.LearningPathItemID, &answer.RequirementID, &answer.AnswerID, &answer.Status); err != nil {
				answers.Close()
				return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, err
			}
			source.Answers = append(source.Answers, answer)
		}
		err = answers.Err()
		answers.Close()
		if err != nil {
			return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, err
		}
	} else {
		var profile, draft, planning, diagnostic, selectable, completed bool
		// Diagnostic completion is append-only, so absence of its result is
		// the authoritative unfinished-state fact. Expired admission fences do
		// not create an indefinite planning wait.
		err := q.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM student_onboarding WHERE student_id=$1),
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM student_onboarding_draft WHERE student_id=$1 AND status='DRAFT' AND version>0),
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM student_onboarding_path_admission WHERE student_id=$1 AND status='RESERVED' AND expires_at>now()),
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (
  SELECT a.id FROM student_diagnostic_assessment_attempt a
  JOIN student_onboarding o ON o.student_id=a.student_id
  WHERE a.student_id=$1 AND a.onboarding_version=o.version
  ORDER BY a.plan_revision DESC, a.reserved_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1
) current_diagnostic WHERE NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM student_diagnostic_assessment_result r WHERE r.attempt_id=current_diagnostic.id)),
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM student_learning_path WHERE student_id=$1 AND status IN ('ACTIVE','PAUSED')),
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM student_learning_path WHERE student_id=$1 AND status='COMPLETED')`, studentID).Scan(&profile, &draft, &planning, &diagnostic, &selectable, &completed)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, err
		}
		switch {
		case selectable:
			source.LifecycleReason = "path_selection_required"
		case planning:
			source.LifecycleReason = "planning_in_progress"
		case diagnostic:
			source.LifecycleReason = "diagnostic_required"
		case completed:
			source.LifecycleReason = "path_completed"
		case draft || !profile:
			source.LifecycleReason = "onboarding_required"
		}
	}

	// Read every owned active binding, including other paths and standalone
	// activities. Required/optional precedence belongs to the domain resolver.
	rows, err := q.Query(ctx, `SELECT practice_task_instance_id::text
FROM student_learning_action
WHERE student_id=$1 AND source_kind='practice_v2' AND lifecycle_status IN ('RESERVED','OPEN')
ORDER BY created_at, id`, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, err
	}
	instances := []string{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var instanceID string
		if err := rows.Scan(&instanceID); err != nil {
			rows.Close()
			return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, err
		}
		instances = append(instances, instanceID)
	}
	err = rows.Err()
	rows.Close()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, err
	}
	for _, instanceID := range instances {
		binding, err := getPracticeLearningAction(ctx, q, "student_instance", studentID+"\x00"+instanceID, false)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, err
		}
		source.Bindings = append(source.Bindings, binding)
		if binding.LearningPathItemID != "" {
			var raw []byte
			err := q.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT i.frozen_requirements
FROM student_learning_path_item i JOIN student_learning_path p ON p.id=i.student_learning_path_id
WHERE p.student_id=$1 AND p.id=$2 AND i.id=$3`, studentID, binding.LearningPathID, binding.LearningPathItemID).Scan(&raw)
			if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
				return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, domain.ErrStateChanged
			}
			if err != nil {
				return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, err
			}
			var requirements []domain.LessonRequirement
			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &requirements); err != nil {
				return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, err
			}
			found := false
			for _, requirement := range requirements {
				if requirement.ID != binding.RequirementID {
					continue
				}
				if requirement.Type != "practice_completed" || requirement.SourceReference.ID != binding.TaskRevisionID || requirement.SourceReference.RevisionID != binding.TaskRevisionID {
					return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, domain.ErrStateChanged
				}
				if source.BindingRequirements == nil {
					source.BindingRequirements = map[string]domain.LessonRequirement{}
				}
				source.BindingRequirements[binding.LearningPathItemID+":"+binding.RequirementID] = requirement
				found = true
			}
			if !found {
				return domain.NextActionSnapshot{}, domain.ErrStateChanged
			}
		}
	}
	return source, nil
}
